payload.reason: The evidence describes how audio and text sequences are combined in a dual RNN architecture for emotion recognition.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to independently encode audio and text data, then combines these encodings to predict emotion classes.
The audio-RNN encodes MFCC features and prosodic features, while the text-RNN encodes word sequences from transcripts, with both outputs combined in a feed-forward neural network.
